fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Leeds offers a one-year master's in Computer Science (MSc). The campus is a 10-minute walk from Leeds city centre. The most important thing to know is the cost. International students pay £34,600 in tuition for the whole course, and the full first-year bill is higher once you add the money your visa asks you to show.

| | MSc Computer Science |
|---|---|
| Length | 12 months, full-time |
| Start | September 2027 |
| City | Leeds |
| Tuition for international students | **£34,600** total for the course |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, with **6.0** or more in each part |

## What it really costs

Leeds quotes tuition as a **total for the course**, not a yearly figure. Because the course lasts 12 months, the total is the first year.

**Tuition deposit.** Taught master's applicants who need a Student visa pay a **£2,000** tuition fee deposit before they receive their CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document your university sends you to start your visa application. The £2,000 deposit is a general taught-masters rule. The MBA is not named on that page. The deposit listed is for 2027/28 entry.

**Living money for the visa.** You must show money to support yourself while you study. Outside London, the rate is **£1,171 a month** for up to **9 months**. You must have held that money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the day you apply.

**Worked first-year cost for MSc Computer Science:**

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition (total for the course) | £34,600 |
| Living money: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee (from outside the UK) | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge: £776 for each year of your visa | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £46,473** |

The sum is £34,600 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 (or more) = at least £46,473. Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164. This is an example, not a budget. The £10,539 is money you show to the visa officer. It is not a fee you pay to Leeds, and your real spending may be different. The Immigration Health Surcharge is £776 for each year of your visa, paid as part of your application.

Visa rules and money figures change. Check them on gov.uk before you apply. Read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) for the full process, and the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown) to compare costs across UK universities.

## Ways to reduce the cost

**Masters International Excellence Scholarship.** This gives a tuition fee discount of **£3,000, £6,000 or £16,000**. It is open to international, fee-paying applicants who are self-funded or partly funded. You need a 2:1 honours degree (a UK honours degree grade) and a full-time taught master's starting in September 2027. The MBA and fully online courses are not eligible. Computer Science is eligible. There are two rounds:

| Round | Apply by | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 28 February 2027 | 2 April 2027 |
| 2 | 16 May 2027 | 11 June 2027 |

**Masters International Regional Scholarship.** This gives a **£6,000** fee reduction to passport holders of India and of other listed countries. The same rules apply: fee-paying, self-funded or partly funded, starting September 2027, with the MBA and fully online courses excluded. Check the scholarship page for the closing date.

## Getting in

To get in to MSc Computer Science, you need:

- **IELTS 6.5 overall**, with no less than 6.0 in any part. IELTS is an English language test.
- The entry degree requirements on the course page. Check them against your own degree before you apply.

For your visa, you also need to prove your English. For a degree-level course, gov.uk asks for CEFR level B2. CEFR is the common European scale for language ability.

Some courses need an **ATAS certificate** (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) before you start. Indian nationals are not on the exempt list, so check whether your course needs one. Gov.uk says an ATAS application takes at least 30 working days (6 weeks) to process.

## Deadlines

| Intake | Start | Apply by (international applicants) | Apply by (UK applicants) |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | September 2027 | 30 July 2027 | 10 September 2027 |

Applications for 2027/28 opened on 1 October 2026. Some courses have an earlier deadline, so check Course Search for the course you want before you apply.

Apply early for your visa. You can apply no more than six months before your course starts. Gov.uk gives 3 weeks for a decision on an application from outside the UK.

## Popular programmes for Indian students

This page covers three master's courses at Leeds. The first is [MSc Computer Science](https://courses.leeds.ac.uk/k299/computer-science-msc). The second is [MSc Data Science and Analytics](https://courses.leeds.ac.uk/i071/data-science-and-analytics-msc), which is also 12 months and starts in September 2027. Its international tuition is **£34,600** total, the same as Computer Science. The third is the [Full-time MBA](https://courses.leeds.ac.uk/a992/full-time-mba), which is **£41,200** total for international students. The MBA is not eligible for the two scholarships above.

## Where you'll live

The campus is a 10-minute walk from Leeds city centre.

Leeds guarantees an offer of university-arranged accommodation to international postgraduate students who pay the international fee, are new to Leeds, need single accommodation, and apply by the deadlines. For September entry, postgraduate applications run from 1 November to 31 July.

The 2027/28 rents below are for 51 weeks. Leeds says all rents for 2027/28 are still provisional, so they may change.

| Residence | Room | Per week | Total for 51 weeks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Blenheim Point | En suite | £207 to £215 | £10,518 to £10,909 |
| Carlton Hill | Postgraduate en suite | £217 to £229 | £11,029 to £11,629 |
| Sentinel Towers | Postgraduate en suite | £165 to £169 | £8,385 to £8,587 |
| Royal Park Flats | Standard room | £132 | £6,726 |
| Lupton Residences | Postgraduate shared | £125 | £6,357 |

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You want a 12-month full-time MSc in Computer Science that starts in September 2027.
- You can reach IELTS 6.5, with 6.0 or more in each part.
- You can pay the £2,000 deposit and show the living money your visa requires.
- You can apply for a scholarship by its round deadline.

**Think carefully if:**

- You plan on tuition alone. The first-year cost in our example is at least £46,473.
- You want a scholarship but cannot apply by 28 February 2027 (round 1) or 16 May 2027 (round 2).
- You need university accommodation and are waiting for the final 2027/28 rents.
- You are looking at the MBA and need a scholarship. Neither scholarship applies to the MBA.

To compare other options, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

faq_json.q: How much does a master's in Computer Science at Leeds cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition for international students is £34,600 for the whole 12-month MSc Computer Science course. Our worked first-year example, including visa money and fees, comes to at least £46,473, because the Immigration Health Surcharge is £776 for each year of your visa.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for Leeds MSc Computer Science?
faq_json.a: You need IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in any part.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Leeds?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Masters International Regional Scholarship gives a £6,000 fee reduction to passport holders of India and other listed countries. Check the scholarship page for its closing date.

faq_json.q: What is the Leeds deadline for September 2027 entry?
faq_json.a: Leeds gives 30 July 2027 for international applicants and 10 September 2027 for UK applicants. Some courses have an earlier deadline, so check Course Search.

faq_json.q: Do I have to pay a deposit to Leeds?
faq_json.a: For taught master's courses, applicants who need a Student visa pay a £2,000 tuition fee deposit before they receive their CAS. The MBA is not named on that page.

faq_json.q: Can I get university accommodation at Leeds as an international student?
faq_json.a: International postgraduates who pay the international fee, are new to Leeds, need single accommodation and apply by the deadlines are guaranteed an offer. The 2027/28 rents are provisional.
